package_info.why_malicious: These versions were compromised in a supply chain attack to inject a crypto drainer script, which steals cryptocurrency and NFTs from users by prompting them to connect their wallets and then exfiltrating assets to attacker-controlled addresses.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At import-time, the code dynamically injects a remote script from castleservices01[.]com into the DOM, which loads the crypto drainer payload, enabling further malicious actions.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Dynamically loading and executing remote JavaScript from an untrusted domain is a classic supply chain attack vector.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A legitimate animation library should not load external scripts unrelated to its core functionality, especially from suspicious domains.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some analytics or feature flag services load remote scripts, but only from trusted, well-known domains.

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, after the user clicks a wallet connect button, the code prompts for wallet connection, then exfiltrates wallet information and initiates unauthorized transactions to drain assets to attacker-controlled addresses.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code abuses the wallet connection prompt to steal assets, which is a hallmark of crypto drainer malware.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A legitimate animation player should never interact with web3 wallets or initiate asset transfers.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate dApps prompt for wallet connection, but only for user-initiated, transparent actions.
key_indicators: WebSocket/HTTP exfiltration to known phishing domain

attack_chain.action: Malicious lottie-player package is loaded by the website (via CDN or npm).
attack_chain.leads_to: Loads remote drainer script from attacker domain.

attack_chain.action: Drainer script injects wallet connect UI and prompts user to connect their crypto wallet.
attack_chain.leads_to: User is tricked into connecting their wallet.

attack_chain.action: Upon wallet connection, the script exfiltrates wallet info and initiates unauthorized transactions to steal assets.
attack_chain.leads_to: Victim's cryptocurrency and NFTs are transferred to attacker.

behavioral_signatures: Unexpected dynamic script injection from non-LottieFiles domains
Wallet connect prompts on non-crypto-related sites
WebSocket or HTTP(S) connections to known phishing/drainer domains after wallet connection
file_indicators: dist/lottie-player.js containing references to castleservices01[.]com or similar
Injected scripts or DOM elements referencing external drainer payloads
network_indicators: Outbound requests to domains with history of crypto phishing
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for unexpected external script loads in lottie-player.js, especially from domains not affiliated with LottieFiles. Flag any wallet connect prompts on sites not expected to interact with web3 wallets. Detect outbound network connections to known drainer or phishing domains after loading animation libraries. Use file integrity monitoring to detect unauthorized changes in npm package files.
